faqs.q: What is the exact displacement, power, and torque of the CHIXIANG CG200?
faqs.a: The CG200 (CX163FML) has an actual displacement of 197.0 cc with a 63.5 × 62.2 mm bore and stroke. Rated max power is 10 kW @ 7,500 rpm and max torque is 13.5 N·m @ 6,500 rpm, with an 8.5–9.3 : 1 compression ratio.

faqs.q: What is the difference between air-cooled CG200 and water-cooled CG200SB?
faqs.a: Both share a 63.5 × 62.2 mm bore and stroke (197.0 cc), but the CG200 uses natural air cooling (31.3 kg, 380 × 355 × 500 mm) for lower complexity and lighter commuter or utility builds, whereas the CG200SB uses liquid cooling (425 × 385 × 530 mm, 10.5 kW / 15.0 N·m) for sustained heavy-load cargo duty.

faqs.q: Can CG200 engines be ordered with a balance shaft or reverse gearbox?
faqs.a: Yes. Standard CG200 ships with a 5-speed constant-mesh forward transmission. Balance-shaft configurations and model-matched reverse gearboxes can be specified per order BOM before Proforma Invoice confirmation.

faqs.q: What is the minimum order quantity and standard export packaging for CG200?
faqs.a: Standard wholesale MOQ is 50 complete engines, and you can mix CG200 with CG150, CB, horizontal, or water-cooled models plus spare parts in one container. Regular production lead time is approximately 10 working days under FOB Guangzhou terms (other major Chinese ports by arrangement).

faqs.q: Are engine mounting dimensions and warranty terms provided?
faqs.a: Yes. Factory installation dimension drawings are supplied with your quotation so your engineering team can verify frame lugs, output shaft spline, and wiring plugs. Every engine undergoes 100% pre-shipment hot and cold bench testing and carries a 60-day warranty after destination port arrival for verified manufacturing or assembly defects.

faqs.q: What is the actual displacement and torque of the CHIXIANG HW300?
faqs.a: The HW300 (300cc Class) has a 74 × 64 mm bore and stroke, yielding an actual geometric displacement of 275.3 mL. It delivers 12.5 kW @ 6,500 rpm and 21 N·m @ 4,500 rpm with a 10.4 : 1 compression ratio.

faqs.q: How does the HW300 differ from standard water-cooled CG250SB engines?
faqs.a: HW300 is built on the heavy-duty HW Water architecture with auxiliary cylinder cooling fins, a 1.5 L crankcase oil capacity, a 20-roller one-way clutch, and a high-output DC magneto—designed for sustained heavy cargo loads and steep gradients.

faqs.q: Which spare parts are shared between HW250 and HW300?
faqs.a: Approximately 80% of core assemblies—including left/right crankcases, 20-roller clutches, 5-speed transmission shafts, water pumps, high-output DC magnetos, and fastener kits—are shared across HW250 and HW300, reducing distributor spare-parts inventory capital.

faqs.q: Does the HW300 include a built-in reverse gear?
faqs.a: No. The HW300 uses a standard 5-speed forward transmission without built-in reverse and is engineered to pair with external cargo-tricycle reverse gearboxes.

faqs.q: Can I consolidate HW300 complete engines with HW service kits in one container?
faqs.a: Yes. Standard wholesale MOQ is 50 complete engines (mixed HW200–HW350 and CG/CB models supported), and factory-matched HW service kits or core assemblies can be loaded in the same container under FOB Guangzhou terms (~10 working days regular lead time, 60-day post-arrival warranty).
